# Descriptions
@@ 1
Detects the presence of all ''entities'' that this spell list affects that are
within the area of effect. Caster may concentrate on a different area each
round.
@@ 2
Subtracts 5 from all attacks against the target made by entities.
@@ 3
All Type I Entities in the area of effect take an ''A'' Holy Spell critical.
Furthermore, as long as the caster concentrates, Type I entities that are in
the area of effect may not leave without making an RR, and Type I entities
that are outside the area of effect may not enter without making an RR.
@@ 4
[RR Mod: -20] Banishes the target Type I entity from this plane of existence
for the duration of the spell. The caster also learns the name of the entity
and may ask it one question which it must answer truthfully.
@@ 5
As Entity Protection I, except the modifier is 10.
@@ 6
As Repel Entity I, except the critical is of severity ''B'', and it affects up
to a Type II entity.
@@ 8
[RR Mod: -20] As Banish Entity I, except affects up to a Type II entity.
@@ 9
As Repel Entity I, except the critical is of severity ''C'', and it affects up
to a Type III entity.
@@ 10
As Entity Protection I, except the modifier is 15.
@@ 12
[RR Mod: -20] As Banish Entity I, except affects up to a Type III entity.
@@ 13
As Repel Entity I, except the critical is of severity ''D'', and it affects up
to a Type IV entity.
@@ 14
As Entity Protection I, except the modifier is 20.
@@ 15
Caster sets up a magical field around the target gate, teleportal, or other
magical portal. Beings attempting to pass through the gate must make a RR
versus the level of the caster with a special modifier of -30. Failure
indicates that the being takes an ''E'' Impact critical and does not pass
through the gate.
@@ 16
[RR Mod: -20] As Banish Entity I, except affects up to a Type IV entity.
@@ 17
As Repel Entity I, except the critical is of severity ''E'', and it affects up
to a Type V entity.
@@ 18
As Entity Protection I, except the modifier is 25.
@@ 20
[RR Mod: -20] As Banish Entity I, except affects up to a Type V entity.
@@ 25
As Repel Entity I, except the critical is of severity ''E'', and it affects up
to a Type VI entity.
@@ 30
[RR Mod: -20] As Banish Entity I, except affects up to a Type VI entity.
@@ 50
[RR Mod: -20] As Banish Entity I, except affects any one entity, and lasts
forever.
